title: Pooling and Consolidation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Eppendorf twin.tec 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL) seated in an aluminum block; USA Scientific 12 × 8‑tube strips (300 µL) seated in an aluminum block; 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock snap‑cap microcentrifuge tube seated in an Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack with 4 × 6 microcentrifuge tube insert; Opentrons GEN1 P10‑single‑channel electronic pipette; Opentrons GEN1 P300‑single‑channel electronic pipette; Opentrons 10 µL filter tip rack; Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack.

steps.title: Set pipette mount sides
steps.instruction: Enter the mount side values for the P10 and P300 single‑channel pipettes in the Opentrons software.

steps.title: Download the protocol
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol file for the pooling and consolidation run.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place labware on the robot deck as follows: slot 2 – 8‑tube strip (strip 1) for initial transfers; slot 3 – 96‑well PCR plate on a 4 × 6 insert of the Opentrons tuberack; tube A1 in the strip designated for pooled sample.

substeps.instruction: Place the PCR plate on the 4 × 6 insert in slot 3.
Identify tube A1 as the pooling destination.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip racks, the PCR plate, the 8‑tube strip, and both the P10 and P300 pipettes according to the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the pooling and consolidation procedure.
